name: Morse.Omega
why: Both define Ω₀ = O(n) and Ω_{k+1} = complex structures anticommuting with J 1, …, J k (indexing from 1, as Milnor, in both: no shift), with no standing hypothesis on the sequence J. The only difference is the written form of anticommutation (J α J' = −J' J α vs J' J α = −J α J'), the same equation; proved by ext.
